name: Projection-Loss Preservation Audit Registry
purpose: Verify that incompleteness and projection-loss remain visible after formal review packaging.

audit_sections.description: Every theorem package explicitly lists lost aspect detail.
Reachability is strictly constrained by CSI local reach.
Asymmetry between continuation and reconstruction is maintained.
Theorems refuse global quantifiers; all results are neighborhood-specific.
Scrutiny acknowledges that observed images are structural artifacts, not total state.

governance_rules.rule: Suppression of projection loss during review triggers an immediate 'INCOMPLETE_DISCLOSURE' flag.
